title: Documents
description: Briefs, specs, meeting notes and decisions across your projects. Every save keeps a version you can go back to.
openComments: {count, plural, one {# open comment} other {# open comments}}
editorPlaceholder: Start writing. Type @ to mention someone.
inTrash: This document is in the trash. Restore it to edit or comment.
readOnly: You can read this document but not edit it.
readOnlyArchived: This project is archived, so its documents are read-only.
newerRemote: {name} saved version {version} while you were editing. When your changes save, you’ll choose how to combine them.
versionsLink: {count, plural, =0 {No saved versions} one {# saved version} other {# saved versions}}

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.hint: Start with a brief, meeting notes or a blank page. Documents save as you type and keep their history.
empty.hintReadOnly: Documents from projects you can open will appear here.
empty.filteredHint: Try a different search or clear the filters.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted documents stay here until you restore them. Their history and comments are kept.
trash.emptyHint: Documents you delete will appear here so you can restore them.

new.title: New document
new.description: Choose where it lives and how to start. You can move it to another collection later.
new.noCollections: This location has no collections yet.
new.titleHint: Leave empty to use the template’s title.

collection.newDescription: Collections group related documents, like “Meeting notes” or “Specs”.
collection.name: Name
collection.locationHint: Only documents from the same project can go in this collection.
collection.deleteBody: {count, plural, =0 {The collection is empty.} one {Its # document stays where it is, just outside any collection.} other {Its # documents stay where they are, just outside any collection.}}
collection.empty: No documents in this collection yet.

move.title: Move “{name}”
move.description: Documents can move between collections of the same project.
move.none: There are no collections here yet. Create one from the Documents page.

trashConfirm.title: Move “{name}” to the trash?
trashConfirm.body: It disappears from lists and search. You can restore it from the trash with its history and comments.

saveState.offlineHint: You’re offline. Your changes are kept in this tab and save when you reconnect. Don’t close it.

conflict.title: Someone else saved this document
conflict.description: {name} saved a newer version while you were editing. Choose what to keep.
conflict.nothingLost: Nothing has been overwritten. Your changes are still here until you choose.
conflict.keepTheirsHint: Load {name}’s version. Your unsaved changes are thrown away.
conflict.copyMine: Copy mine to clipboard, then load theirs
conflict.copyMineHint: Your text goes to the clipboard so you can paste the parts you need.
conflict.overwriteHint: Save your version on top. {name}’s version stays in the history.
conflict.copied: Your version is on the clipboard. Loaded the latest version.
conflict.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy to the clipboard. Your changes are still here.

share.title: Client access
share.label: Share with client
share.onHint: Client contacts can read this and see client-visible comments.
share.offHint: Only your team can see this document.
share.noClient: Link this project to a client to share documents.
share.portalOff: The client portal is off for this project, so contacts can’t open it yet.
share.unsharedToast: No longer shared with the client
share.saveFirst: Save your changes first, then change sharing.

preview.title: View as client
preview.description: How client contacts see this document in the portal: read-only, last saved version.
preview.notShared: Clients can’t see this document. Turn on “Share with client” to make it visible in the portal.
preview.portalOff: The client portal is off for this project. Contacts will see this once it’s turned on.
preview.footnote: Internal comments are never shown to clients. Unsaved changes aren’t included.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.empty: No reviews of this document yet.
approvals.emptyCan: Ask teammates or the client to approve an exact version of this document.
approvals.saveFirst: Your latest changes couldn’t be saved, so the review wasn’t requested.

approval.title: Request approval
approval.shareFirst: Share the item with the client to ask a client contact.
approval.pinnedDocument: The document is frozen into a version now. Later edits won’t change what reviewers approve.
approval.pinnedFile: Reviewers decide on version {version}. Uploading a newer version reopens the review.

historyPage.title: Version history
historyPage.description: A version is kept for each editing session, and whenever a version is named, sent for review or restored.
historyPage.name: Name this version
historyPage.nameHint: Give the current state of the document a name, like “Sent to client” or “Final draft”.
historyPage.restoreBody: The document goes back to version {version} as a new version. The current text is kept in the history, so nothing is lost.
historyPage.emptyHint: Versions appear after the first save.
